changes: Avoid exception via early exit in patches
Added the logic for handling detail heightmaps, disabled in the planet.vert shader for now
Replaced BiomeMaterialReference TextureReferences with a new subclass TerrainMaterialReferences, which inherit from PbrMaterialReference with the inclusion of a displacement map
Defined macros for the remaining planet shader bindings to make sure they match across other passes using the same layout on the shader side
Added three biomes to Luna - Main, Craters, and Maria. Each biome has subtly different surface materials but share a cliff material.
Added terrain shader support for per-biome slope/cliff materials.
Added a distance based anti-tiling solution to the terrain shader. Currently tiling depends on log3(distance) rather than log2 to mitigate details looking oddly large from far away.
Added terrain shader support for the per-biome roughness-metallic-occlusion PBR textures.
Added a WIP IMGUI terrain shader debug editor which will be populated with more editable values later, off by default.
Added 4k biome ID and control textures for Luna.
Optimized terrain shader GPU memory bus usage using dynamic branching to skip texture samples that won't contribute to the final result.
Remove references to automation from README.md
Added ability to translate individual ship parts with mouse/keyboard.
Added ability to rotate individual ship parts with keyboard. Mouse SoonTM Ships parts now have two highlight states 'hover' and 'grabbed' for user feedback.
Moved planet shaders to their own dedicated folder as housekeeping to prepare for prototyping terrain tessellation
Instance buffer is a bit less cluttered and utilizes a more dynamic approach via device vector and 'safe' buffer wrappers.
Switched from mailbox to fifo presentation mode which fixes vsync on Windows.
Added a toggle between a new "map" mode and local mode using the M key. This "map" mode just zooms out to the currently-followed vehicle's parent for now.
Fixed issue where closest approach markers were no longer being drawn after the change of the internal units from AU to Meters.
Fixed out of range issue displaying escape markers on maneuver patches.
Fixed issue of collection changing when drawing patch lines on maneuver flight plans.
Fixed issue of porkchop texture and mouse-over alignment not working correctly. x == y != x != y. ie. X and Y axis confusion between texture and mouse corrected.
WIP fixes to automatic maneuver solver. More to come on this. Fixed solver using inconsistent reference frames.
Added markers on the porkchop plot showing the best transfer position and the currently selected transfer position.
Improved map view camera transition animations to preserve more visual context.
Separated mouse smoothing from camera transitions.
Added smootherstep function to math library.
Added logging and detection of some hyperbolic patched conics and true anomalies as NaN
Attempted fix to race condition when loading.
Fixed the game crashing on start up when due to setting input listeners before we were ready to handle listeners
Alright so apparently those listeners need to be set before ImGui is initialized so we'll just do a loading check in the listeners as a quick and dirty fix.
Renamed a function overload of textureNice to textureNiceSplit to avoid a crash on MacOS.
Added scroll wheel depth translation for parts

Added terrain tessellation and displacement mapping. Currently off by default because the detail textures aren't tiled enough, so right now each rock is about 50 meters across! Tessellation is also disabled if the host hardware doesn't support it.
Added a terrain shader debugger which includes options to display the biome ID and control maps, PBR textures, and a texture sample heatmap.
Added a terrain tessellation toggle in the main graphics settings.
The planet and global buffers' stageFlags have been updated so that they're passed to the tessellation control and tessellation evaluation shader stages as required for terrain tessellation.
Improved the performance of the distance anti-tiling terrain shader implementation by replacing all divisions with multiplications and flipping the power fraction.
Fixed TerrainMaterialReference not loading the displacement map by marking the base class Get() function as virtual and overriding it to return the proper type.
Add volumetric exhausts: Use a custom method to adjust the plume resolution based on number of plumes visible per-pixel to maintain performance and use depth-aware upscaling

Add separate emissive and absorbing/scattering components to plumes, add multiple settings to control the plume shape, size and noise over time. Use separate per-plume sample count settings for raymarching samples and self-shadowing samples
Make scattering/absorbing component receive shadows from the craft and from planets, with a setting to disable the former for performance
Add phase functions for scattering component
Track multiple separate pulses travelling down the same plume using a small ring buffer
Connect existing thrusters to visual plumes
Add basic configs for Apollo RCS thrusters, add some example configs for thicker starship-style plumes
Add possibility to sample non-lienarly for thicker absorbing plumes
Add a 0.1x time compression speed for tweaking animated visual effects
Use a simpler approximation for the cloud and plume multiple scattering
Add a thruster to CSM engine and use a placeholder plume for it
Checking in a couple of small camera improvements made while diagnosing some part dragging issues.
Added the ability for vehicles to have multiple rocket engines. For the moment, they share the same throttle control and there is a bit of unsavory duplication to clean up.
Changed the CSM SPS from a thruster to an engine.
Removed the lazy setters from XML reference objects so it's easier to tell when init-time setup isn't done properly. Also saves us runtime branches.
Replaced Exhaust_Noise_64.png with the empty white texture until it's checked in.
Mouse translations of parts with proper handling of rotations of all parent frames.
Check in missing exhaust noise texture
Fix for storage buffer missing from a descriptor set which causes issues on MacOS
Cleaned up some conversions with translating objects
Added basic material properties to the biome materials and load them from the system XML.

Restructured the planet biome material buffer. It now stores two BiomeMaterials (one for the surface and one for the slopes) which contain their texture IDs and material parameters. This means we have independent control over each surface material so they can use different tilings and texture intensities.
Added shader-side per-biome material parameter blending.
Completed a first pass optimization of the terrain shader for SIMD instructions

Added basic planet biome material editing to the terrain shader GUI. This allows for in-game editing of planet terrain materials, and will be extended if or when we have more parameters. Note that this is a debug menu for now.
Added XmlAttribute 'Name' to biome materials to more easily track them in the editor GUI.
Object mouse translation now per frame rather than per mouse position changed

Replaced on font scale with a new scaling system that regenerates the font texture, providing a smooth font when scaled. Included font scaling options that users can configure, such as rasterize density. This will help if users are using custom fonts for other languages.
Fixed game settings window could not be resized and would always recenter. Now it will be sized and centered on open, but will be able to be changed by the user after that.
Added a new default monospaced font that scales better than the default imgui one, which would not scale.
First step towards multiple windows, viewports and cameras
We support multiple viewports (within the same window for now) but only one can be rendered at a time for now
Each viewport has it's own camera and controllers so that they can be controlled independently
Changed some Pipelines to use DynamicState for dynamic Viewport and Scissor sizes without needing separate pipelines for each viewport

Added mouse rotations for selected objects which should finish up the very basic translation/rotation functionality. The modifier for rotation is keypad 0 and keyboard translation/rotation uses the rest of the numeric keypad keys for now.
Added maneuver info into the flightplan UI.
Added Edit and Delete buttons for maneuvers to directly edit or delete maneuvers from the flightplan UI.
Added Maneuver.SafeForeach<T> to be wrapped by try catch to ignore collection changes (this is used by UI only so collection changes are ok and picked up next draw of the UI).
Added Days property to SimTime struct. Allows devs to also see all Times in Days in debug.

Cleanup of the game settings window. Now all widgets will show if they are different from applied settings. Currently using a variety of yellow colors, across both text and boxes, rather than a single red on some elements. This should be more consistent.
Added check when leaving settings menu if changes have not been applied, and if so a popup is shown to the user.
Cleanup of popup code, including proper implementation of the new popup system for the old popups like the restart required.
Fixed a bug with restart required popup where it would always apply your changes immediately, regardless of whether you wanted to restart or not.
Added key assignment to opening settings menu, instead of the hardcoded assignment to Escape.
Fixed Sun was showing as yellow in space when it should be white. Perhaps this will stop people messaging me about it.
Added AscendingNodeTrueAnomaly to Orbit class.
Added DescendingNodeTrueAnomaly to Orbit class.
Added TimeOfTrueAnomaly to Orbit class.
Changed GetTimeToTrueAnomalyAtGameTime to GetTimeFromToTrueAnomalyAtGameTime to better reflect what the method actually does.
Added Intersects method to FlightPlan class to test if a flightplan intersects a passed in Astronomical body and return the result.
Added mid-course correction burn maneuver to automatic maneuver transfer planner when a plane change is required. - This is still WIP.
Add downscaling of textures so it can run on weaker GPUs (currently bypassed and only used for internal testing)
Fixed refresh rate setting would be ignored when window settings were changed.
Added full Glfw support to the Console Action. Now you can add Glfw modifiers to any assignment for toggling the console open/closed.
Changed closestapproach marker drawing in UI to include any closest approaches when ANY maneuver for the entire vehicle flightplan is active.
Fixed changing maneuver Time via input fields (not gizmo) was not updating the maneuver time correctly.
